packageGranularity.identity: styleId + target body SHA + fit id/version/SHA + asset/manifest SHA

packageGranularity.notes: rootjoin-v2 preserves source/fit/manifest identity and retained failed attempts
rigid head accessory with exact rootjoin-v2 dependency; not a hairstyle row

bodyType.finding: Catalog and manifests use compatibleBodies/targetBodySha256 hashes. No explicit bodyType field is present in hairstyle rows or hairstyle manifests, so bodyType-to-SHA provenance must be resolved by an outer profile/query layer.

styleId.finding: Explicit fit rows carry fit.styleId and manifest.id/fit.id/version identity. Legacy standalone manifests omit fit identity.

fit.finding: v1/v2 rigid or spring fit records and native character-hair-fit-v3 are validated against exact body/resource hashes. Several legacy rows rely on legacyImplicitFit and have no fit object.

dynamic.finding: Rigid short/sidepart fits declare no dynamics. Ponytail packages declare hair-spring-v1 with six joints and three colliders. native-hairset001 declares VRMC_springBone with 59 joints and 22 colliders. Catalog and package runtimeAccepted remain false, so this is mechanism evidence rather than runtime admission.

provenance.finding: The jaw fit has an explicit provenance object. Long-hair and hat producer scripts pin source inventory, license, generator and dependency bytes, but published hairstyle fit JSON does not carry a provenance object. Most preset fit JSONs have no provenance field.

reusableQueryLayer.behavior: Queries exact style id and exact compatible body hash, requiring exactly one row. hairFitIdentity returns explicit-fit-v1 (fit id/version/SHA) or legacy-head-local-v1 (manifest SHA). validateHairFitData checks body/style/resource identity and rigid/spring/native structure.
reusableRows: Short bob and male sidepart v1/v2 rows can share the query and validator when the requested body hash has its own row.
Ponytail v1/v2 rows can share the query and validator for their listed body hashes. The same source asset SHA does not make a fit transferable to another body.
native-male-hairset001-v1 uses the native-hair-attachment validator and can share the selection/query contract for its exact body row.
nonReusableByInference: No implicit cross-body reuse. Derived female bodies m1a-jaw-v1 and m1a-waisthip-v1 are not admitted for the current ponytail source (evidence/m2-derived-hair-admission-audit-v1/report.json).
Hat package depends on rootjoin-v2 but is an accessory dependency, not proof of a second hairstyle or double-ponytail mechanism.

legacyImplicitFitRisk.finding: These rows set legacyImplicitFit=true and expose no fit id/version/SHA. Their manifests omit version, explicit fit and source-body provenance fields. Saved legacy records can only identify the manifest SHA and are rejected when a caller requests legacy compatibility against an explicit-fit row. They must not be treated as equivalent to explicit v1/v2 fit rows.

shortHair.evidence: female-bob-v1 and male-sidepart-v1 rigid head-local assets, with explicit body-specific v1/v2 rows plus legacy rows.
shortHair.gap: Keep use scoped to exact body rows. Close bodyType/provenance and runtime/visual admission before presenting as a generally reusable short-hair family.

mediumLengthHair.evidence: No medium-length styleId or package is present. Existing bob is a neck-length rigid asset and ponytail is a long spring asset.
mediumLengthHair.gap: Produce a dedicated medium-length package or explicitly classify an existing asset, with exact styleId, body fits, attachment/physics declaration and runtime evidence.

ponytail.evidence: female-ponytail-v1 rootjoin-v2 and female-ponytail-headref-v3 provide one six-joint spring chain and three colliders. Producer/runtime CPU checks pass, while runtimeAccepted remains false and derived-body admission is false.
ponytail.gap: Complete target-body runtime/visual and record/reload admission, plus provenance closure. Do not promote CPU/source evidence to game acceptance.

doublePonytail.evidence: No double-ponytail styleId, asset, fit or dual-chain dynamic record exists.
doublePonytail.gap: Create a distinct package with two independently skinned/dynamic tails, explicit colliders and body-specific fits, then run the same producer, runtime, recovery and visual evidence sequence.

evidence: docs/CAPABILITIES.md HAIR-01 and hair production notes
conclusion: The project has a reusable exact-body query and several frozen hairstyle production packages. Explicit body/style/fit/resource identity is strongest in v1/v2 preset rows and native v3, while bodyType and provenance closure are incomplete and legacy rows remain implicit-fit. Short and single-ponytail mechanisms exist as body-scoped candidates. Medium-length and double-ponytail mechanisms are absent. No listed hair package is runtime-admitted.
